scripts.dev: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm --parallel --filter @bazhen/daemon --filter @bazhen/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run build:hook && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @bazhen/web run build
scripts.test:api: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project api
scripts.check: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-standards.ts && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/protocol-schema.ts --check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:hook && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:medium && pnpm run test:bench
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm --filter @bazhen/e2e-tests run test
scripts.test:medium: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project medium
scripts.test:hook: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/hook/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --quiet --manifest-path apps/hook/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo test --quiet --manifest-path apps/hook/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:bench: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project bench
